Tape the various areas shown in the figure with masking tape.

Conduct a road test, gradually bringing the vehicle up to the speed where the noise starts: if the rustling noise persists, conduct the preliminary locating test on the whole car (70).

Remove the masking tape from area A and repeat the road test: if the noise persists, adjust the door hinges (see PROCEDURES OP. 7010A14). Remove shims from the top hinge, or add shims to the bottom hinge, so that the door adheres better to the seal.

Remove the masking tape from area B and repeat the road test: if the noise persists, adjust the door hinges (see PROCEDURES OP. 7010A14). Remove or add shims on the two hinges, to make the door adhere better to the seal.

Remove the masking tape from area A and repeat the road test: if the noise persists, check the condition of the door seal in that area and that it adheres correctly to the bodywork (see PROCEDURES OP. (7010A34) also check that the glass seal fits correctly (with glass closed).

Remove the masking tape from area D and repeat the road test: if the noise persists, check the condition of the window glass seal (see PROCEDURES OP. 7010D26).
